functionalReqs: Create topics; publish messages to a topic
Each subscriber gets every message in order
Subscribers consume independently (slow ones don't block fast ones)
Reset a subscriber's offset to replay
hints: If the publisher calls each subscriber directly, one slow subscriber blocks everyone. How do you decouple?
Store messages in a per-topic list; give each subscriber its own offset and worker.

Topic holds an append-only list of Messages; TopicSubscriber pairs a Subscriber with an AtomicInteger offset; one worker thread per subscriber waits (wait/notify or BlockingQueue) and consumes; Broker/Queue facade manages topics; retention trims old messages.
nonFunctionalReqs: Bounded memory or a retention policy
problemStatement: Design an **in-memory publish-subscribe** library: publishers send messages to topics, and every subscriber of a topic receives them, each at its own pace.
title: Design a Pub-Sub System
